main_text.p: contra Photium. Deiecto postmodum Photio, & restituto Ignatio mittitur ad Pontificem; petiturque ab eo, vt insinuet, quid agendum sit de Sacerdotibus, qui Photio adhaeserant. Pontifex mittit Legatos suos, vt cuncta rite disponerent, & causa Photij, atque Ignatij a Romano Pontifice discutitur, & internoscitur, & mortuo tandem Ignatio, & restituto Photio, petitur rursus a Romano, vt illum in communionem suscipiat, eiusque ad Patriarchatum reditum sua auctoritate firmet. Eijcitur iterum Photius, & iterum ad Romanum Legationes, & literae, vt Acta confirmet, & cum Stephano Patriarcha dispen-set[?], & cum Episcopis deceptis a Photio, qui mandat utriusque partis Episcopis mitti, quibus auditis sententiam pronunciet. Vides hic Romanorum Pontificum dominatum ab ipso Christo illis exhibitum super Ecclesias non ex ambitione vindicatum? Photianis temporibus, & anteactis, & postmodum subsecutis Pontifices Romani mandant, imperant, poenis etiam indictis Imperatoribus, Patriarchis, Episcopis, universis Christi fidelibus; lites inter eos exortas examinant, ponderant, & solo suo arbitrio discernunt, & sententia definiunt, in iudicio de rerum veritate inda-

page.notes: Printed text is in roman type with long s rendered as f; transcribed as plain s. The page opens mid-paragraph with no indent, so the first paragraph is marked as a continuation. The Ejicitur/Eijcitur and iudicio/judicio spellings are copied as read; "Eijcitur" is printed with i and j as read. "dispen-set" is read from the hyphenated "difpen-" / "fet" across the line end and is doubtful. A small mark at the bottom left is not a legible signature and is left out. No marginal notes and no running head are printed.
